notes.text: Elfsight says the account owner can ask its support team to disable its visitor view-count cookie for all widgets in that account. This does not disable cookies used by embedded social platforms; its guide identifies Facebook, YouTube and Tumblr as possible additional sources. Review the actual widget type when choosing this account-wide setting.

For Elfsight widgets with a font selector, choose Default (Apply from Website) to inherit your site fonts instead of loading Google Fonts through the widget setting. Check the widget type: Elfsight says its Google Maps app can still load Google Fonts while fetching location data, despite having no font selector.
